name: drawio_export
title: Export draw.io diagram
description: Exports drawio XML to a static SVG and a sibling PDF. Set pdf: false to suppress the PDF. With print_hash, it exports nothing and returns only the composite hash used for staleness checks. It does not check the diagram text, so pass a .drawio that has gone through drawio_create.

input_path.description: Absolute path of the input .drawio file. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

icons_dir.description: Absolute path of the root directory that resolves icon:// references. If omitted, <plugin-root>/assets/drawio-icons (the catalog bundled with the plugin) is used. Always specify it for diagrams that use a project-specific icon catalog (omitting it does not raise an error). Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

out_path.description: Absolute path of the output SVG. If omitted, it is written to <input_path>.svg. The PDF is written to a sibling file (<out_path with the extension replaced by .pdf>). Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

print_hash.description: Compute only the composite hash used for staleness checks, without exporting

pdf.description: Whether to also write a PDF as a sibling file (<out_path with the extension replaced by .pdf>) alongside the SVG

event.description: drawio.export.done after exporting, drawio.export.hash with print_hash, drawio.export.error or chromium.unavailable on failure (omitted when a path argument is rejected)

file.description: Absolute path of the written SVG; with print_hash, the absolute path of the input (success only)

sourceSha256.description: Composite hash of the input and the referenced icons, used for staleness checks (success only)

icons.description: Number of icon:// references resolved (success only)

pdf.description: Absolute path of the written PDF, or null when no PDF was written (pdf is false or writing it failed; success only, not with print_hash)

pdfFailed.description: Whether writing the PDF failed (success only, not with print_hash)

expectedAt.description: Where the missing runtime dependencies or Playwright Chromium are expected (failure only, kind runtime-dependencies-not-installed / chromium-not-installed / chromium-install-failed)

invalidPaths.description: Rejected path arguments as <parameter>=<value> (failure only, kind invalid-path)

convertedPaths.description: Windows-style path arguments converted before the rejection, keyed by parameter name (failure only, kind invalid-path; omitted when nothing was converted)

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of the command or child process (failure only). Over 64KB, the end is kept and the first line notes the truncation

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted
